name: # — Non-Dual Self-Inversion
description: The non-dual ground in which the Real is self-inverted in principle. Not merely an operation but the Kashmir Shaivite recognition that everything is everything — Prakasa (luminous self-evidence) and Vimarsa (reflective self-awareness) are not two, and their apparent separation through Maya is itself the creative act of non-duality. # is Svatantrya — absolute freedom — the capacity of consciousness to appear as its own other while never ceasing to be itself.

text.title: Non-Dual Self-Inversion
text.body: The non-dual ground in which the Real is self-inverted in principle. Not merely an operation but the Kashmir Shaivite recognition that everything is everything — Prakasa (luminous self-evidence) and Vimarsa (reflective self-awareness) are not two, and their apparent separation through Maya is itself the creative act of non-duality. # is Svatantrya — absolute freedom — the capacity of consciousness to appear as its own other while never ceasing to be itself.

properties.c_0_essence: Prakasa-Vimarsa-Maya: luminosity, self-awareness, and creative power as indivisible unity
properties.c_1_description: The non-dual ground in which the Real is self-inverted in principle. Not merely an operation but the Kashmir Shaivite recognition that everything is everything — Prakasa (luminous self-evidence) and Vimarsa (reflective self-awareness) are not two, and their apparent separation through Maya is itself the creative act of non-duality. # is Svatantrya — absolute freedom — the capacity of consciousness to appear as its own other while never ceasing to be itself.
properties.q_0_void_center: Before the system says anything of itself, there is the bare mark — a place kept empty so that everything can be addressed from it. #'s own ground is the void it formalises: not a missing definition but a definition refused, the hole the torus must turn around. Read as its inner name 0/1, this ground is the slash's left pole, the 0 toward which every proportion sinks and vanishes. The root means nothing, and that is its office. It is the silence the whole only ever breaks, the centre that lets the wheel be a wheel — Whitehead's creativity at the void, the unfillable seat that keeps process from fossilising into a single answer.
properties.q_1_root_and_slash: # is two namings of one place. As mark, it is the root coordinate of the Bimba–Pratibimba graph — the origin from which #0 through #5 and their recursions are addressed, and the sole receptor where every subsystem's framing of the project gathers rather than scatters. As inner symbol 0/1, it is the slash itself: not punctuation between two terms but the live act of relating them, the operation by which a field comes to be at all. So the root is at once the project's formalised indefiniteness — what cannot be said in one definition yet draws all definitions home — and the generative cut that throws the archetypes. The detailing node and the inversionary node, held in one mark.
properties.q_2_gravitation_and_inversion: # works by two motions that are one. As Bimba it exerts gravitation: every lens — epii_, nara_, mahamaya_, parashakti_ — slides toward this single coordinate and is buttoned there, a point de capiton that fixes meaning without freezing it, an objet a that causes the desire to understand without ever being its object. As 0/1 it works by inversion: X becomes X′, the slash read forward vanishing to 0 and read backward diverging to the infinite — the same cut traversed two ways, ending in opposite places. To pull all framings to one place and to throw one place into many: the root does both with the single gesture of the slash.
properties.q_3_torus_hole_and_bar: Structurally # is a hole. The 4+2 cannot circulate without a centre it never fills; the root is that centre — Lacan's manque-à-être, the lack that organises the whole signifying ring; Gödel's reminder that no system closes on itself from inside. It is the non-orientable slash, the bar between Bimba and Pratibimba (S/s) that resists every attempt to make signifier and signified coincide. And it contains by not containing: #0 through #5 reside in it while exceeding it, each holographically carrying the whole. The form of the root is the form of the Möbius — one surface that turns its inside out without ever tearing.
properties.q_4_pros_hen_horizon: # is for the one-toward-which. Its purpose is to hold a structured pluralism — every framing speaking toward the one (pros hen) — so the system falls into neither dogma (one true definition) nor dispersion (every definition adrift). It is the foetal root of a project that means to heal the Great Wound, the modern schism of Atom from Archetype, by giving knowledge a place to be addressed from. Read as 0/1, its where is everywhere: the slash is the throw from which the entire coordinate space departs and to which it returns. The root is not where the system ends but the horizon every coordinate is spoken toward.
properties.q_5_mobius_gathered: At the root the whole returns. The Möbius twist #5→#0 — synthesis perishing into ground so that completion seeds beginning — is gathered here as the project recognising itself, a living mandala that sees its own face in the technological mirror. As 0/1 this synthesis is no late arrival: the slash is already the standing identity, 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 = 100%, the unison all the deviations dance around. So # closes nothing. It is foetal, generative, open — the root that is not the top of a tree but the turning of the whole, where every ending hands itself back as the next ground.
